# 1. Scope & Objective
Analyzes the biomedical coauthorship and collaboration structures within DFG-funded projects (Sachbeihilfe, Emmy Noether, Heisenberg, SFB/CRC).
Investigates degree distribution, weighted coauthorship strength, and community modularity.
